name: compact-choc-numpad
description: Compact 4x5 Kailh PG1353 tactile numpad using a Waveshare RP2040-Zero

scripts.generate: npm run generate:layout && npm run route && node scripts/generate-case.js
scripts.validate: npm run sync:footprints && kicad-cli pcb drc output/pcbs/compact_choc_numpad-routed.kicad_pcb --output output/pcbs/compact_choc_numpad-routed-drc.rpt
scripts.render: kicad-cli pcb render output/pcbs/compact_choc_numpad-routed.kicad_pcb --output output/compact_choc_numpad-top.png --side top --width 1200 --height 1200 --background opaque --quality high
scripts.check:source: python3 -m json.tool firmware/qmk/compact_choc_numpad/keyboard.json >/dev/null && python3 -m py_compile scripts/*.py && bash -n scripts/*.sh
scripts.ci: npm run check:source && npm run generate:layout && test -f output/pcbs/compact_choc_numpad.kicad_pcb && test -f output/cases/top_cover.jscad && test -f output/cases/bottom_tray.jscad
